_about.split: *_quadrant keys use four 90-degree facing sectors centred on E, N, W, S (heading_matrix) and compare only opposite sectors (N vs S, E vs W); the other keys are recomputed here (on CPU) as in summary.json, with heading invariance and decoding on 180-degree halves
_about.stability: place_inv_quadrant_over_stab_median divides by the same split-half stability as summary.json: even vs odd walks, all headings
_about.decoding: decode_cross_quadrant / decode_within_quadrant: ridge trained on one sector (even walks), tested on the opposite / same sector (odd walks), mean over the 4 sectors
_about.chance: decode_cross_heading_chance / decode_cross_quadrant_chance: median error of predicting the training half's / sector's mean position on the opposite one; decode_chance as in summary.json
